head: SANS
dzh: 红橙主色、大价格、优惠券
nzh: 价格用大号粗体数字，原价灰色划线；限时、包邮这类小标签用色块；优惠券金黄色带锯齿边，倒计时醒目；信息多但分区清楚，主按钮通栏
nen: Big bold price numerals, old price struck through in gray; small colored tags like Limited and Free shipping; gold notched coupons and a prominent countdown; dense but clearly sectioned, full-width main button
